plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for IP Infusion OcNOS switches (enterprise PEN 36673, CMM-CHASSIS-MIB). Besides interface traffic and uptime, it reports per-unit CPU and memory utilization, chassis temperature sensors, fan speed and state, and power-supply state and temperature.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of each OcNOS stack unit as a 0-100 percentage. CMM-CHASSIS-MIB cmmStackUnitCpuUtilization reports 0.01 percent units and is divided by 100 at collection so stored values, dashboards and alerts are already in percent.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total RAM of each OcNOS stack unit in bytes. CMM-CHASSIS-MIB cmmSysRamTotalMem reports megabytes and is multiplied by 1048576 at collection so stored values are already in bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: RAM utilization of each OcNOS stack unit as a 0-100 percentage from CMM-CHASSIS-MIB cmmSysRamUsedMem (already a percentage in the MIB; values outside 0-100 are dropped).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature of each OcNOS sensor in degrees Celsius. CMM-CHASSIS-MIB cmmSysTemperatureValue reports 0.01 ℃ units and is divided by 100 at collection so stored values, dashboards and alerts are already in ℃.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan rotational speed of each OcNOS fan in RPM from CMM-CHASSIS-MIB cmmFanRpm. Negative values, values above 50000 RPM, and the unavailable / not-applicable sentinels are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each OcNOS fan from CMM-CHASSIS-MIB cmmFanStatus, normalised to 1=normal (running) / 2=abnormal (notpresent, faulty, stalled, or unknown). Values not defined in the MIB enumeration are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each OcNOS power supply from CMM-CHASSIS-MIB cmmSysPowerSupplyOperStatus, normalised to 1=normal (running) / 2=abnormal (notpresent, faulty, or unknown). Values not defined in the MIB enumeration are dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature of each OcNOS power supply in degrees Celsius. CMM-CHASSIS-MIB cmmSysPSTemperature1 reports 0.01 ℃ units and is divided by 100 at collection so stored values, dashboards and alerts are already in ℃.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
